criteria.requirement: Add Cache.peek(key,default=marker), returning a live value without invoking subclass __getitem__, __missing__, recency/frequency updates or expiry cleanup. Use each cache existing membership semantics, so TTL/TLRU expired entries behave missing; explicit defaults including None are returned, otherwise raise KeyError. Support all built-in cache policies, weighted sizes and custom __missing__ subclasses. Preserve ordinary get/item access behavior and all internal policy accounting.
